steps.name: initialize: refused for a stranger, done by the upgrade authority; fee capped at 1%
list SOL and a 6-decimal test token; a stranger cannot list
shield 1 SOL, 0.5 SOL, 500 tokens; a 1-lamport deposit is refused; wallet finds all three notes
attack: a deposit whose logs are cut off is still synced and found (sync reads instruction data)
alice sends 1.2 SOL privately to bob; relayer submits; asset hidden
bob finds 1.2 SOL; alice finds 0.3 SOL change; spent notes drop out
bob unshields 1 SOL to a fresh address (0.995 after the fee); relayer paid 0.002 SOL; a pre-funded nullifier address did not block it
replaying the same proof is refused: NullifierAlreadySpent
redirecting the payout or doubling the amount after proving is refused: InvalidProof
honest token unshield goes through: 100 tokens out, 1 token to the relayer
pause: deposits refused, a withdrawal still goes through
pool books match its vaults; protocol fees accrue apart from them
a stranger sweeps the fees to the fixed fee recipient; wrong destinations are refused
